description: This Java class, PersistenceIdSource, provides functionalities to create streams of entity ID revisions for known entities. It interacts with Akka streams and actors to manage asynchronous, resumable data streams of entity snapshots, primarily used for persistence or event sourcing in the system. The class includes methods to build resume sources, handle errors, and process source references, focusing on streaming entity revisions efficiently.

classes.name: PersistenceIdSource
classes.description: A utility class for creating and managing streams of entity ID revisions, facilitating resumable and resilient processing of entity snapshot data within an Akka streaming environment.

classes.name: EmptyEntityIdWithRevision
classes.description: A private inner class serving as a default lower bound placeholder for the entity ID stream, representing an empty or initial state.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a source stream of entity IDs with revisions for all known entities, handling failures by retrying with backoff.

methods.name: buildResumeSource
methods.description: Constructs a resumable source that can recover and continue streaming entity revisions with specified backoff and restart policies.

methods.name: checkForErrors
methods.description: Checks the result of message sending via the pub-sub mediator, returning a failed source if an error occurred.

methods.name: requestStreamCommand
methods.description: Builds a command message to request a stream of entity IDs from a given actor path.

methods.name: sudoStreamPids
methods.description: Creates a SudoStreamPids object configured with streaming parameters and a lower bound entity ID.

methods.name: handleSourceRef
methods.description: Processes a reply object to extract and convert it into a source stream of entity ID revisions.

methods.name: createSourceFromSourceRef
methods.description: Converts a SourceRef object into an Akka source stream of entity ID revisions.

methods.name: failedSourceDueToUnexpectedMessage
methods.description: Generates a failed source in case of unexpected message types during stream processing.
